current_qualified_reassessment.candidate_criterion: A legitimate request, selected worker and role assignment must not be accepted as fulfilment unless the actual actor has the required capability and current permission, and performance is separately evidenced.
current_qualified_reassessment.author_reasoning: Current C007 already separates effective ability and permission, and C098 separates attempts from effects. The protocol phases are interpreted under the selected protocol: FIPA contract-net accept-proposal can establish the award/acceptance effect, and a later inform-done is not a universal second acceptance requirement. The corrected lineage protocol qualification is preserved.
current_qualified_reassessment.original_parent_removal_and_lineage_test: Preserved at exact original candidate identity. Core adjudication is read; repeated per-parent templates/remaining-set identities are not represented as new empirical ablations.

r2_attribution_reassessment.attribution_impact: The executor named in the capability/permission test must be the one actually controlling the operation; role allocation or a reported action cannot substitute for this match.
r2_attribution_reassessment.subsumption_judgment: The added relation identifies a partial input or constraint of the already inherited criterion. It changes a displayed realization or its warrant, not the bearer-level criterion. Existing rejection/unsupported-strengthening conclusion remains.
r2_attribution_reassessment.parent_removal: Remove EAA-001 as a separate realization while supplying the same actual actor/action/objective map through an adequate direct native interface: the protected function can remain. Remove the required information itself: that particular realization can fail, without proving a new property identity.
r2_attribution_reassessment.lineage_removal: The retained inherited subsumer still exists in the full denominator; removing a lineage from one displayed route is not deletion of that criterion from science. The attribution relation does not establish irreducible three-lineage necessity.

r3_correlation_reassessment.current_reasoning: Task allocation identifies the selected responsible performer at its binding event; actual capability and permission qualify admissible use, and performance is separately observed. Do not require a second acknowledgment absent from the selected protocol.
r3_correlation_reassessment.subsumption: The current native EAA001 attribution criterion and the named inherited obligation, effect, compatibility and memory criteria remain the bearer-level tests. Additional partial producer/use relations do not exhibit a residual criterion beyond them.
r3_correlation_reassessment.parent_removal: Delete the dedicated correlator but supply an adequate direct call/task or operation record: the attribution function can remain. Delete all adequate binding/evidence for the consequential use: that realization may fail, without proving a new property.
r3_correlation_reassessment.lineage_removal: A displayed route can depend on several inherited inputs; removing a lineage from that route is not proof of an irreducible new three-lineage property. Full inherited subsumers remain in the novelty comparison.

r4_control_scope_reassessment.current_reasoning: A bound decision or scoped mapping can identify which executor/selector is being described at the relevant stage. Selection, capability, permission and observed performance remain independent: an escalation or generated role is not the requested actor completed operation.
r4_control_scope_reassessment.subsumption: The inherited EAA-001 boundary criterion and the existing decision, observation, obligation, effect, compatibility, memory and implementation criteria retain their bearer-level tests. The new contribution supplies or constrains one existing premise at a stated level; it introduces no residual new satisfaction criterion.
r4_control_scope_reassessment.parent_removal: Remove the named record-producing mechanism but provide an adequate direct explanation, inspected input or covered correspondence result: this use can remain. Remove every adequate input for the specific consequential premise: that instance loses warrant, which is not proof of a new property.
r4_control_scope_reassessment.lineage_removal: These finite routes do not prove all three lineages are jointly necessary. A narrower configuration or adequate substitute can omit a route while preserving the claimed function; the existing qualified source predicates remain the comparison baseline.

r6_component_reassessment.current_reasoning: A task exchange or allocation specifies the selected holder, and a mission binding specifies an assigned objective. These are necessary descriptive inputs only where consumed by the delegation question. Capability, legitimate permission, executable dependencies and realized performance require their own evidence; payment or a role label supplies none automatically.
r6_component_reassessment.parent_removal: An adequate direct authorized allocation and performance check can replace bargaining or mission machinery.
r6_component_reassessment.lineage_removal_and_residual: Assignment and its implementation obligations remain inherited; no new all-lineage delegation property is demonstrated.
r6_component_reassessment.retained_decision: Existing native rejected/no-new-property decision unchanged; relation/constraint integration only.

r10_corrective_reassessment.current_reasoning: The active-actor witness and implementation map refine the existing capability/authority/delegation correspondence. They neither authorize the executor nor establish a new irreducible delegation property.
r10_corrective_reassessment.parent_removal: The exact inherited per-parent tests remain. Removing the named EAA artifact while supplying an adequate ordinary actual interface/fixture preserves the criterion. Removing all actual necessary information or support defeats that realization of the inherited criterion; it does not demonstrate that all full parents passed with a new residual predicate.
r10_corrective_reassessment.lineage_removal: The preserved native subsumers and ordinary alternatives suffice for the identified criterion without a new mandatory three-lineage mechanism. Removing a lineage can remove this explanation or instance, not establish an irreducible new property.
r10_corrective_reassessment.contrary_case: Compatible types, complete diagrams, labels, local passes or a finite domain can fail to establish the stronger consequence. Those proxies are not complete satisfaction of the inherited predicates.

r11_native_consumer_reassessment.current_reasoning: Independent validation of an already authorized revision refines the inherited capability/authority/evidence separation. It does not create a new delegation or self-permission principle.
r11_native_consumer_reassessment.parent_removal: Exact inherited per-parent tests remain. Removing a named artifact/algorithm while an adequate ordinary substitute supplies the protected function can preserve the full criterion. Removing the actual necessary distinction/support may defeat that existing criterion; it does not show all parents satisfied with a new residual.
r11_native_consumer_reassessment.lineage_removal: Inherited native subsumers and direct alternatives explain the current finite function without a new mandatory three-lineage mechanism. Removing a lineage may remove this explanatory route or implementation, not establish an irreducible new property.
r11_native_consumer_reassessment.contrary_case: A fixed proof, code-conformance pass, message label, restricted representation or artifact count can coexist with a failed actual condition. Such a proxy is not complete satisfaction of the inherited predicate.

r12_method_consumer_reassessment.current_reasoning: Delegation realised by an authorised capable executor retains its exact native parent/subsumer criteria and original removal tests. No new direction supplies a changed parent criterion or an irreducible residual failure for this candidate. The added engineering-record inputs cannot replace its actual operational, evidence or resource premises.
r12_method_consumer_reassessment.parent_removal: Exact original per-parent removal tests remain. Removing a necessary information function can defeat an already inherited criterion; removing one encoding while an adequate truthful substitute supplies that function need not. Neither is a witness of a new criterion with all full parents satisfied.
r12_method_consumer_reassessment.lineage_removal: No new irreducible three-lineage necessity is shown. The added relations join EAA and EAOSE, and a direct conventional artifact can realize the selected function; their representation does not make a third lineage indispensable.
r12_method_consumer_reassessment.countercontrol: A label, incomplete view, unbound receipt, missing criterion or benign-only sample may pass a proxy while a full inherited premise fails. Do not count that as full-parent satisfaction.

r13_memory_reassessment.current_reasoning: Delegation realised by an authorised capable executor keeps its original criterion, native subsumers and removal tests. The new local experience inputs do not supply a residual counterexample with all full inherited premises satisfied.
r13_memory_reassessment.per_parent_and_lineage_removal: Original removal tests remain exact. Removing a needed evidence function can defeat an inherited criterion; removing one storage/retrieval realisation while a sufficient carrier remains need not. Neither establishes a new criterion or all-three-lineage necessity.
r13_memory_reassessment.criticism: The six cases are constructed partial inquiries, with common code and explicit premises. They cannot establish emergent effectiveness, novel formal guarantee, independent replication or practical authority.

r14_comparison_reassessment.current_reasoning: The local, human and tool variants share final effects but differ in actual selectors. This improves attribution at the chosen scope without establishing authorised delegation or executor capability for another task.
r14_comparison_reassessment.per_parent_and_lineage_removal: Original criteria, native subsumers and parent/lineage removal tests remain exact. Removing a needed input defeats an inherited criterion, while replacing its realisation by an adequate direct carrier need not. The finite component/composite countermodels supply no residual criterion under all full parent premises and no all-three-lineage necessity.
r14_comparison_reassessment.criticism: Three new author groups share four finite traces and exposed truth/authority/cost premises. The additional relation is neither a new property nor independent empirical confirmation; later evidence may reopen the current zero-new-property judgment.

r15_memory_reassessment.current_reasoning: An architecture assessor receiving warranted experience is not an authorised capable task executor merely by that fact. Stored success and monotonic consistency do not imply feasible delegated execution.
r15_memory_reassessment.per_parent_and_lineage_removal: All original native subsumers, parent/lineage removal tests and criteria remain exact. The new edge supplies a bounded operand to existing native operations; no residual criterion under all parent premises or necessary three-lineage contribution is established.
r15_memory_reassessment.criticism: Three logical groups share one finite instrument. The partial contradiction and stochastic countermodel bound this new input; no independent replication, whole-method benefit or novelty quota is inferred.

r16_memory_reassessment.current_reasoning: A recipient of experience may be an evaluator without being an authorised executor. Utility improvement, resource suitability or correct computation supplies neither capability nor delegated action authority.
r16_memory_reassessment.parent_and_lineage_removal: Original native subsumers, parent and lineage removal records remain exact. The current witnessed function can be lost by removing its actual operand yet replaced by an adequate direct input; this does not remove inherited criteria from the full denominator or establish a residual property. No third-lineage necessity is manufactured.
r16_memory_reassessment.criticism: Finite constructions are dependent and do not establish global efficacy, comparative net benefit or acceptance. Existing incompatibility, obligation, budget and source-dependence witnesses remain.

r17_boundary_reassessment.judgment: The local protocol-input correction does not provide a new predicate beyond this candidate’s retained native subsumers, nor invalidate its original parent/lineage-removal and adequate-alternative reasoning. Original decision, primitive membership, subsumers and counterexamples remain exact; no unexamined independent positive review is claimed.

exact_displaced_negative.r9_prior_reentry: A particular source-native output and consequential matched receiving use may reopen this scoped decision. current_attribution_realization.question: Q1
current_attribution_realization.judgment: Join the same actual actor/action/objective binding to the current authority, obligation and effect context. Correct binding supplies a partial input; none of those neighboring predicates is thereby proved.

current_correlation_realization.question: Q1
current_correlation_realization.judgment: Use one compatible actor/task/operation/epoch context for the claimed join. Correlation, public-stage evidence, current capability/permission and external effect are separate partial inputs. A correct key cannot fill another missing predicate.

current_control_scope_realization.question: Q1
current_control_scope_realization.judgment: A coherent consequential account aligns entity, evidence level, episode, operation and stage. Matching labels or individually valid records do not suffice for a whole join.

The interaction model permits the corresponding request and a completion path.
The role model correctly distinguishes a drafting clerk from a supervisor with refund authority.

current_memory_claim.claim: A correctly bound experience/retention mechanism can supply an actual input or constraint while truth, consent, authority, completion and whole-system assurance remain separate.

mechanisms.EAA: EAA030 preserves the actual warrant/context of experience; EAA031 selects retention by legitimate future purpose and relevance.
mechanisms.EMAS: EMAS059 supplies unresolved work/effect context and the actual recovery consumer, with public transition semantics remaining separate.
mechanisms.EAOSE: C105 supplies live responsibility/valid transition, C109 preserves uncertain effects, and C111 bounds legitimate custody and access.

higher_order.joint_guard: An identified earlier action or obligation has a material future recovery/transition consumer and the information is legitimately available to that consumer. No universal memory, coordination layer or dedicated owner follows.
higher_order.non_entailments: Attempt history does not establish effect occurrence; disappearance of the process does not discharge a promise; retention does not grant authority; a correct destination does not close predecessor obligations.
higher_order.adequate_alternative: M03 supplies the same bounded information through an authorized external register. Current state or a direct sufficient operation contract can also discharge the function when adequate.
higher_order.parent_removal: Removing the local memory implementation while retaining the same adequate information preserves the protected function. Removing the actual unresolved obligation/effect consumer removes this particular retention reason, subject to other legitimate duties. EAA/EMAS/EAOSE source-lineage removals in AMA-RQ-N001 show overlapping subsumers; no irreducible three-lineage property is established.
